details:
This update for distribution fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-37236: github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2/runtime: client can override the HTTP method of a POST
  request through the X-HTTP-Method-Override header and bypass established access control (bsc#1277966).
- CVE-2026-41178: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/baggage: no rejection of raw-length headers in baggage parsing allows for DoS
  via oversized inputs (bsc#1276677).
- CVE-2026-63209: github.com/klauspost/compress: signed integer overflow in s2.NewDict() allows an attacker to bypass
  repeat index validation and cause a process crash (bsc#1283762).
- CVE-2026-78669: golang.org/x/net/http2: excessive CPU consumption from repeated initial window changes (bsc#1285297).
- CVE-2026-81871: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlplog/otlploggrpc: OpenTelemetry-Go: TLS certificate bypass
  allows log telemetry interception and alteration (bsc#1281468).
- CVE-2026-81872: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log: OpenTelemetry-Go: Denial of Service via attacker-driven log emission
  (bsc#1281469).
- CVE-2026-84303: google.golang.org/grpc: xDS RBAC HTTP filter implementation issue allows for bypass of authorization
  policies via mixed-case or canonical-case header matches (bsc#1279316).
- CVE-2026-84304: google.golang.org/grpc: heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame fragmentation (bsc#1279219).
- CVE-2026-84445: google.golang.org/grpc: DoS via crash due to missing ':authority' and 'Host' headers in gRPC-Go xDS
  servers (bsc#1278997).

Changes for distribution:

- Update to version 3.1.2:
 * build(deps): bump actions/setup-go from 6.4.0 to 7.0.0
 * build(deps): bump the docker-actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates
 * chore(release): prepare for v3.1.2 release
 * build(deps): bump actions/deploy-pages from 5.0.0 to 5.0.1
 * build(deps): bump the codeql-actions group with 4 updates
 * ci: dependabot: group CodeQL and Docker action updates
 * registry: remove logrus-logstash-hook dependency
 * chore(docs): fix build status badge
 * build(deps): bump docker/metadata-action from 6.1.0 to 6.2.0
 * chore(deps): bump oltp version
 * chore(ci): bump alpine image version
 * fix(deps): update deps to fix security vulns
 * docs: explain Redis Sentinel configuration
 * Fix lint
 * fix(deps): bump grpc dep to fix sec vuln
 * fix(handlers): defer context cancellation on Shutdown to stop upload purger
 * chore(build): Bump go version to latest 1.26
 * fix(s3): use path.Dir instead of filepath.Dir in directoryDiff
 * fix(ci): fix broken minio image
 * docs: fix 'allows to rewrite' grammar in rewrite storage middleware
 * Fix 500s from malformed manifest digests and out-of-order final chunk PUTs
 * test: use ephemeral ports for registry listen tests
 * configuration: migrate to go.yaml.in/yaml/v2
 * chore(deps): github.com/sirupsen/logrus v1.10.2
 * chore(deps): github.com/stretchr/testify v1.12.1
 * chore(deps): github.com/docker/go-metrics v0.1.0
 * docs: fix CloudFront Origin Path guidance for S3 driver
 * fix(tags): return empty array after final pagination marker
 * build(deps): bump google.golang.org/grpc
 * fix(client): verify blob content against requested digest in Get
 * fix(client): verify manifest content against requested digest
 * rename errcodeErrorsFor -> toErrcodeErrors
 * pass thru upstream error code
 * docs: document catalog.maxentries configuration
 * fix(storage): don't drop catalog repos that prefix another name
 * fix contentRangeRegexp to accept unknown total size
 * fix(s3): tags/list drops tags that are a lexical prefix of another tag
 * fix: check backend directly in blobStore.Put to avoid stale cache
 * azure: fix race condition in PutContent causing duplicate append writes
 * fix(s3): add redirectendpoint validation and fix doc formatting
 * build(deps): bump docker/metadata-action from 6.0.0 to 6.1.0
 * build(deps): bump github/codeql-action from 4.35.5 to 4.36.0
 * build(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.1.0 to 4.2.0
 * build(deps): bump docker/bake-action from 7.1.0 to 7.2.0
 * build(deps): bump codecov/codecov-action from 6.0.0 to 6.0.1
 * chore: smol go fix changes
 * build(deps): bump github/codeql-action from 4.35.4 to 4.35.5
 * Fix blob type migration in the azure driver
 * build(deps): bump github/codeql-action from 4.35.3 to 4.35.4
 * build(deps): bump actions/labeler from 6.0.1 to 6.1.0
 * build(deps): bump github/codeql-action from 4.35.2 to 4.35.3
 * build(deps): bump github/codeql-action from 4.35.1 to 4.35.2
 * build(deps): bump softprops/action-gh-release from 2.6.1 to 3.0.0
 * fix: report error in `DeleteManifest` when `Delete` returns `ErrDigestUnsupported`
